<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen]]
**The [[United Arab Emirates]] announces a partial withdrawal of its forces from [[Yemen]] as part of a "strategic redeployment". [https://edition.cnn.com/2019/07/08/middleeast/uae-partial-withdrawal-yemen-intl/index.html (CNN)]

;Business and economy
*[[Deutsche Bank]] announces lay-offs – roughly 18,000 job cuts – around the globe as part of a "reinvention", scrapping its global equities and cutting its [[fixed income]] operations. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-deutsche-bank-strategy/axe-falls-on-18000-deutsche-bank-jobs-in-8-3-billion-reinvention-idUSKCN1U309P (Deutsche Bank)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/07/08/business/dealbook/deutsche-bank.html (''The New York Times'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*Flash flooding in [[Washington, D.C.]] delivers a month's worth of rain on the local area in the span of an hour. The torrential rain leaves commuters stranded on car rooftops, floods several metro stations and causes flooding in the [[White House]]. [https://www.cnet.com/news/drain-the-swamp-scary-dc-flooding-spreads-to-the-white-house/ (CNET)]

;International relations
*[[African Continental Free Trade Agreement]]
**African leaders agree on a continent-wide [[free trade zone]], which encompasses all [[African Union|African nations]] except for [[Eritrea]] and [[Somaliland]]. The various European territories located in Africa are also excluded. It will be the largest [[free trade zone]] since the creation of the [[World Trade Organization]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/african-leaders-launch-landmark-55-nation-trade-zone/a-49503393 (DW)]

;Law and crime
*The [[International Criminal Court]] declares [[Bosco Ntaganda]] guilty of having committed [[war crime]]s during the [[Ituri conflict]] in the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/icc-convicts-congo-warlord-bosco-ntaganda-of-war-crimes-including-rape-and-murder/a-49508655 (DW)]
*[[Tax returns of Donald Trump]]
**[[Governor of New York|New York Governor]] [[Andrew Cuomo]] signs a bill that will allow [[United States Congress|congressional committees]] to access [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]]'s state tax returns. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/07/08/nyregion/trump-ny-taxes-cuomo.html (''The New York Times'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Greek legislative election]]
**Winner of the general election [[Kyriakos Mitsotakis]] is sworn in as the new [[Prime Minister of Greece]], succeeding [[Alexis Tsipras]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-greece-election-oath/greek-conservative-mitsotakis-sworn-in-as-prime-minister-idUSKCN1U312Y (Reuters)]
*[[Pope Francis]] names for first time in Vatican history female members of the [[Congregation for Institutes of Consecrated Life and Societies of Apostolic Life]]. [https://www.catholicnewsagency.com/news/pope-francis-names-women-members-of-consecrated-life-congregation-44558 (Catholic News Agency)]
